app.title: SimsLink
library.title: Library
library.subtitle: {installed} mods installed · {active} active
library.broken_repair_confirm.title: Attempt repair?
library.broken_repair_confirm.message: '{name}' will be backed up, then its files re-packaged into a .ts4script and installed. This is best-effort only — it can fail silently if the original extraction was incomplete, in which case the mod still won't work even after this.
library.broken_delete_confirm.title: Delete this folder?
library.broken_delete_confirm.message: '{name}' will be backed up, then permanently removed from Mods/.
library.extract_zips_confirm.title: Choose which archive(s) to extract
library.extract_zips_confirm.message: '{name}' will be backed up. Each archive you select is extracted and installed as its own mod; anything left unselected stays in the backup only.
library.extract_zips_confirm.none_select: Select at least one archive first.
library.save_state_confirm.title: Save current state
library.edit_namespace_button_title: Correct this grouping (often a guess, not a confirmed author)
library.edit_namespace_confirm.title: Correct this grouping
library.edit_namespace_confirm.message: This label is a guessed grouping, not necessarily the mod's real author — it's only ever confirmed when connected to CurseForge. Applies to all {count} mod(s) currently under it. Leave empty to go back to automatic grouping.
library.script_mods_warning: ⚠ Script Mods Allowed is off in the game's options — .ts4script mods won't load.
library.unzip_banner.unzip_all_confirm.m: Extracts {count} single-archive mod(s) currently sitting unzipped. Anything with more than one archive is skipped — those need to be reviewed individually.
library.duplicates_banner.resolve_all_no: None of the current duplicate groups have a clear "which one is the copy" signal (e.g. no author data on either side) — review them individually instead.
library.duplicates_banner.resolve_all_co: Only applies to the {count} mod(s) already presumed redundant (an author or name-suffix signal points at them specifically) — groups with no such signal are left for you to compare and resolve manually.
library.compat_quarantine_banner.toggle: {count} mod(s) flagged incompatible with your game version
library.compat_quarantine_banner.confirm: {count} mod(s) are pre-selected below — deselect any you want to keep active. This only disables them (reversible from Settings once they're updated), it never deletes anything.
Select at least one mod to pause.
library.missing_mods.toggle: ↺ {count} mod(s) you might want to reinstall
library.conflicts.broken_mod_fix_confirm: '{name}' will be backed up, then its archive ({zips}) will be extracted and installed as a new managed mod. The original folder is removed afterward.
library.rezip_fix_confirm.title: Re-extract this mod?
library.rezip_fix_confirm.message: '{name}' currently contains a zip archive instead of loadable files — most likely it was manually re-zipped in place. It will be backed up, then re-extracted and reinstalled from that archive.
library.detail.author: by {value}
library.detail.conflict_duplicate_packag: These mods share {count} identical .package file(s) — likely the same mod installed twice, or one bundling the other's files. Pick which one to keep below.
library.detail.conflict_ts4script_collis: These mods all ship a script file named '{filename}' — only one may actually load. Pick which one to keep below.
library.detail.dedup_partial_error: Some of the other mods couldn't be resolved: {errors}
library.dup_compare.title: Duplicates found
library.dup_compare.instructions: Click the folder to keep — the others will be deleted.
library.delete_confirm.title: Delete mod?
library.delete_confirm.message: This removes '{name}' from the library permanently.
catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.subtitle: Browse and install mods from CurseForge.
catalog.assisted_mode_notice: Catalog browsing requires a valid CurseForge API key. In Assisted Mode, browse mods in your web browser and install them via the download watcher instead.
updates.title: Updates
updates.subtitle: Check for and apply mod updates.
updates.direct_notice: Checking compares each installed mod's file against the latest release CurseForge currently serves.
updates.assisted_notice: Automatic update detection isn't available in Assisted Mode. Open a mod's CurseForge page to check manually — downloading a new version will be picked up automatically by the download watcher.
updates.empty_assisted: No installed mods have a known CurseForge link yet.
updates.update_all_message: This will update {count} mods, backing up each one's current version first:
cache.suggest_message: Mod changes can leave stale cache entries behind, which can themselves cause crashes. Clear now?
crash.no_exception_file: No lastException.txt found — nothing to analyze.
crash.no_suspects: No suspect found directly in the trace.
crash.bisection_round: Testing: disabled {mods}. Relaunch the game, then report what happened.
crash.bisection_inconclusive: Bisection finished without isolating a single mod.
crash.confirm_faulty: Confirm this mod caused the crash
settings.title: Settings
settings.backup_retention_notice: Set via BACKUP_RETENTION_COUNT in .env — a replaced mod's oldest backups beyond this count are purged automatically.
settings.paths_notice: Changing the library or game user folder automatically moves your installed mods to the new location. A restart is needed afterward for the change to fully take effect (the real-time folder watcher keeps watching the old location until then).
settings.paths_saved_notice: Paths updated — restart SimsLink for the change to fully take effect.
settings.path_warnings.game_dir_no_execu: This doesn't look like a Sims 4 install folder (no TS4_x64.exe/TS4_DX9_x64.exe found under Game/Bin/) — saved anyway.
settings.mods_watcher_notice: Set via MODS_WATCHER_ENABLED in .env — catches mods added/removed outside SimsLink while it's running.
settings.logging_notice: Set via LOG_LEVEL in .env (DEBUG/INFO/WARNING/ERROR/CRITICAL) — controls both the log file above and console output.
settings.full_scan_notice: Recomputes every file hash — can take a while on large libraries.
settings.full_scan_result: Scanned {mods_scanned} mods · {mods_imported} newly imported · {files_hashed} files hashed · {files_removed} removed.
settings.loose_mods_notice: Adopts .package/.ts4script files sitting directly at the root of Mods/ (no folder of their own) as individually-tracked mods, tagged "Loose" so they're easy to find afterward.
settings.loose_suggestion_name_required: Enter a name for the merged mod.
library.merge_compare.title: Mergeable mods
library.merge_compare.reliability_linked: Confirmed on CurseForge — safe to merge.
library.merge_compare.reliability_unlink: Not linked to CurseForge — merging isn't guaranteed to reconstruct the mod correctly.
library.match_curseforge_modal.none_to_c: Every loose mod already has a CurseForge link — nothing to check.
library.match_curseforge_modal.stopped: Stopped — {matched} of {checked} mod(s) identified so far. Nothing found so far was lost.
library.sync_curseforge_modal.stopped: Stopped — {synced} of {checked} mod(s) synced so far. Nothing found so far was lost.
settings.namespaces_notice: Clears every manually corrected Library grouping label (the edit icon on an author-group header) — affected mods revert to normal author/prefix inference. Doesn't touch any mod's real "author" field.
settings.clear_namespace_overrides_confi: {count} mod(s) currently have a manually corrected grouping label. This reverts every one of them to automatic author/prefix inference — the labels themselves aren't recoverable afterward.
settings.blacklist_notice: Local and manual only — flags installed mods whose name or id matches a pattern you've entered here. Never blocks anything by itself.
settings.compat_quarantine_notice: Mods paused by the Library's "Incompatible mods" banner. Reactivate here once an update (checked via "Synchronize") fixes them — a mod still marked incompatible is left alone.
settings.compat_quarantine_release_resul: {released} reactivated, {stillIncompatible} still incompatible, {failed} blocked on a dependency
downloads.detected_message: New file detected: {filename}. Install this mod?
downloads.detected_replace_message: New file detected: {filename}. This looks like an update for '{mod_name}'. Replace it?
